# The research desk end to end, with a fake agent and a stand-in for curl. A question splits into two sections. One child run reads each section.
# The reader of the first section also states a claim whose quote is not on the page: the quote check drops it. The judge gets a planted false claim and rejects it.
# A person approves the draft. The desk reads the cited pages again, and publishes the report once.
[!exec:jq] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

rdinit
rdfakes
env HOME=$WORK/home
env RESEARCH_DESK_DIR=$WORK/rd
env RESEARCH_HOME=$WORK/store
env SEARCH_API=http://search.test
env WIKI_API=http://wiki.test
env RESEARCH_HEADER_FILE=$WORK/home/.research/credential.header

exec obeereal check workflow rd/workflow.star
! stdout .
! stderr .

exec obeereal item add research-desk cold-cost --title 'Cold and cost' --body-file body.txt
exec obeereal run cold-cost research-desk --workflow rd/workflow.star &

waitstatus 'paused: Review the draft report of cold-cost'
! exists wiki.log
exec obeereal answer cold-cost approve
wait
stdout 'item cold-cost finished'

cmp calls.log expected-calls.log

# The invented quote is kept in the store as not found, and it does not reach the judge or the report.
grep -count=1 '"quote_ok":false' store/cold-cost/s1.1/claims.jsonl
! grep '90 percent' store/cold-cost/report.md

# The planted claim was in the claims of the judge, got the verdict unsupported, and is not in the report.
grep -count=1 '"canary":true' store/cold-cost/s1.1/claims.jsonl
grep '"canary":true.*"verdict":"unsupported"' store/cold-cost/s1.1/claims.jsonl
! grep 'opposite' store/cold-cost/report.md

# The report cites the claims that passed. It was published once, and the page holds the same text.
grep 'Cold cut the output by 30 percent. .c1.' store/cold-cost/report.md
grep 'The unit costs 12 euro per month. .c4.' store/cold-cost/report.md
grep -count=1 '^cold-cost-' wiki.log
cmp store/cold-cost/report.md wiki.page

exec obeereal status
stdout 'item-cold-cost-r1\tdone'

-- body.txt --
How does the cold change the output of a unit, and what does it cost?
-- expected-calls.log --
plan
read cold
judge
write Output
read cost
judge
write Cost
abstract
-- home/.research/credential.header --
Authorization: Bearer TESTONLY
-- resp/_search --
{"results":[{"url":"http://pages.test/page/a"},{"url":"http://pages.test/page/b"}]}
-- resp/_page_a --
<p>Winter tests. At -20 C the output fell by 30 percent.</p>
-- resp/_page_b --
<p>The unit costs 12 euro per month.</p>
